@description: Adds Markdown editing and live preview to workspace comments, with Ctrl+M to toggle between edit and preview modes.
@settings/defaultMode.description: Which mode a newly opened comment starts in. Use "edit" or "preview".
@settings/shortcut.description: Keyboard shortcut used to switch between edit and preview mode, e.g. Ctrl+M or Alt+M.
@settings/allowHtml.description: When enabled, raw HTML inside comments is passed through instead of being escaped. Only enable for trusted projects.
@settings/showIndicator.description: Show the small mode label next to the toggle button in the comment top bar.
